t.Alle MP3-Dateien dieses Ordners in zufäl: Play all MP3 files of this folder in random order, each once per session

Endless: after the last file of a folder a new round begins. Random (button at the folder): every file plays once per session, the order is different every time and never starts with the file the last session started with.

t.Lautstärke, die nach dem Start gilt und: Volume that applies after the start and when nothing else is set.
t.Dauer, in der eine geänderte Lautstärke: Time in which a changed volume (slider, REST, MQTT) moves to the new value while sound is playing; 0 = immediately. Via REST and MQTT the time can be given per call with ms.
t.Webradio ein- und ausblenden: Fade web radio in and out
t.Dauer, in der ein laufendes Webradio vor: Time in which a running web radio is faded out to volume 0 before an announcement or MP3 file and faded in again after the continuation; lowering when mixing also uses this time; 0 = immediately.
t.Dauer des Einblendens beim Start eines W: Time of fading in when a web radio starts, of fading out when it stops and of both when the station changes; 0 = immediately.
t.Erlaubte Pins am ESP32-S3: 1-18, 21, 33-: Allowed pins on the ESP32-S3: 1-18, 21, 33-42, 47, 48. Every pin may only be used once; otherwise the pins are not saved.
t.Radio unter Ansagen weiterlaufen lassen: Keep the radio running under announcements
t.Ansagen (und bei Webradio auch MP3-Datei: Announcements (and, with web radio, MP3 files too) are laid quietly over the running web radio or a running MP3 file, which keeps playing without interruption. Off: the radio stops for the announcement and is reconnected afterwards; an MP3 file stops as well.
t.Lautstärke des Radios während der Ansage: Volume of the radio during the announcement as a percentage of the set volume.
t.Beim ersten Abspielen einer MP3-Datei mi: On the first play of an MP3 file the device measures its loudness in the background and matches it to a uniform level; the correction is stored, the file itself stays unchanged. During the measurement (a few seconds up to a minute) the file still plays unchanged and is then adjusted gently. Announcements and radio stay unchanged.
t.Stichworte der Titelregel: • Mehrere Sti:
Keywords of the title rule:
• Separate several keywords with a comma or semicolon.
• Upper/lower case does not matter; it is enough if the title contains the keyword.
• With =value (0-100) a keyword gets its own volume, for example: Cambodia=90, Thunder
• Empty = rule off.
t.Lautstärke (0-100) für Stichworte ohne e: Volume (0-100) for keywords without their own value; it applies as long as the title plays, afterwards the previous one again.
t.Ein Sender meldet das Ende eines Titels: A station does not report the end of a title. With a value greater than 0 the title rule ends after that many seconds (for example 210 for a title of 3:30), so that ads after the title do not stay loud; 0 = until the next title.
t.Spielt nach dem Start nach einigen Sekun: Plays station 1 of the list a few seconds after the start, as soon as WiFi is up and the stream answers. When off, the device stays silent after the start.
t.Beim Einschalten und nach einem Neustart: On power-up and after a restart from the web interface the device plays a short tone (“buub”) at the set volume. After a restart via MQTT, after a crash and in safe mode it stays off.
Off (default): the device starts silent. On: a few seconds after the start it plays station 1 of the list in the Web radio tab, as soon as the stream answers (up to 10 attempts 6 s apart).
t.Zuletzt gespielten Sender nach einem Neu: Resume the last played station after a restart
t.Merkt sich den laufenden Sender mit sein: Remembers the running station with its volume and plays it again after a restart or power failure; a stop deletes the memory.
t.Das Gerät merkt sich Sender und Lautstär: The device remembers station and volume (only when the volume has been unchanged for 3 s). After a restart it plays the station again with the same volume; a stop deletes the memory, then the device starts silent. This checkbox takes precedence over “Play station 1 at start”.

t.Keine Nutzlast: startet das Gerät neu. <: No payload: restarts the device. Do not send retained, otherwise a saved command is ignored after connecting.

t.Weitere Sprachen kommen als Datei (zum B: Further languages come as a file (for example en.json) into the memory of the device and are applied in the browser. The button in the status bar switches the language.

Fetches the log again every 10 seconds.
t.⚠ Aktualisierung fehlgeschlagen - letzte: ⚠ Refresh failed - last state is shown
t.Alle Aufrufe gehen an <code>http://{host: All calls go to http://{host}.local/ or to the IP address. Parameters can come as a form (-d), as a query (?text=...) or as flat JSON in the body; GET calls are allowed, for example for home automation. Response: {"ok":true,"msg":"..."} or, on an error, HTTP 400 with {"ok":false,"error":"..."}. Announcements and MP3 files go into a queue (up to 8) and play one after another; a station command takes effect immediately, a stop empties the queue.
t.Anschlüsse von ESP32-S3, MAX98357A-Verst: Connections of the ESP32-S3, MAX98357A amplifier and SD card reader (optional). The GPIO numbers in the picture are the pins set in the Audio tab.
t.Webradio oder MP3 per URL: Web radio or MP3 by URL
t.<code>url</code> muss mit http:// oder h: url must begin with http:// or https://. /api/play takes url or file, /api/url only a URL. Optionally vol. Web radio over https needs a lot of RAM, http streams are uncritical. If a web radio is running and an announcement or an MP3 file comes, the radio is faded out and stopped for it (so silent), the announcement is played and the radio is then reconnected with the old volume; before that it is faded out gently and faded in again when it continues (duration in the Audio tab, default 700 ms). A web radio is faded in slowly at the start (from idle), faded out slowly at the stop, and when the station changes the old one is faded out and the new one faded in slowly (Audio tab, default 1500 ms). If the same station is chosen again it simply keeps playing; a live stream continues live, not at the same place. /api/stop ends the radio without continuation, a new URL command replaces it.
t.Dateien der SD-Karte (FAT32, nur MP3) we: Files on the SD card (FAT32, MP3 only) are addressed with the name sd:/Folder/File.mp3, in file of /api/play and /api/file and likewise via MQTT (/file, /play). If the name ends with /, the device plays all MP3 files of the folder one after another (sorted by name); they enter the queue one at a time, announcements in between come first. With shuffle=1 the order is random per session and every file comes once, the first is never that of the last session of this folder; with loop=1 a new round begins after the last file (reshuffled with shuffle, the first file is never the one played last). A new station or a stop ends the session. /api/sd?dir=/Folder lists a folder, /api/sdmount mounts the card again. File manager: upload with /upload?target=sd&dir=/Folder, /api/sdmkdir (dir, name), /api/sdrename (path, to), /api/sddelete (path; a folder is deleted with its contents) and /api/sdfile?path=... to download. Names are cleaned (umlauts rewritten, spaces become underscores).
t.Im Tab Webradio lassen sich 15 Plätze mi: In the Web radio tab 15 slots can be saved with name, URL and their own volume (empty = general volume; a vol in the call takes precedence). n is the slot number (1-15), alternatively name (case does not matter). /api/stations returns the used slots (JSON with n, name, url, vol), /api/stationdelete deletes a slot (name and URL), the following slots move up.
t.<code>file</code> ist der Dateiname aus: file is the file name from the MP3 (Flash) tab. There are buttons for every file that copy the finished call. /api/files returns the list, /api/delete deletes a file. Uploading works via /upload (form, field file).
t.<code>enable</code> schaltet das Log in: enable switches the log to the file on (1) or off (0), the default is off. clear=1 empties the file. Without parameters GET returns the state. /log returns the content as text.
t.MQTT-Broker per API setzen: Set the MQTT broker via API
t.<code>/api/scan</code> (WLAN-Suche), <co: /api/scan (WiFi search), /api/testNtp?server=... (NTP test, only needed in the Time tab), /api/topbarStatus (status bar), /api/version (firmware version), /export and /import (settings without WiFi passwords, with API key), /restart (POST, restart).
t.Setzt nur Broker und Port (optional auch: Sets only broker and port (optionally also user and pass), everything else stays unchanged. GET returns broker, port, user and connected; the password is never output.
t.<code>text</code> (Pflicht, höchstens 50: text (required, at most 500 characters), optionally lang (e.g. de-de, en-gb), voice (e.g. Hanna), rate (-10 to 10), vol (0-100). Without a value the settings from the VoiceRSS tab apply. The API key must be saved.
t.Basis-Topic <code>netspeaker/{host}</cod: Base topic netspeaker/{host} (can be changed in the MQTT tab). Payload as text or as JSON. /say: text or {"text":"...","lang":"..","voice":"..","rate":0,"vol":60}. /play: URL or file name, also {"url":"..."} or {"file":"..."}. /url URL only, /file file name only, /station slot 1-15 or name (also JSON {"n":3} or {"name":".."}). /stop without payload. /volume 0-100. /restart without payload restarts the device (do not send retained; a message in the first 3 s after connecting is ignored). Coming back are /status (idle, loading, playing, error: ...), /now (what is playing right now, for example "Station name - Title") and /availability (online, offline). /volume/state (volume currently in effect) and /volume/general (general) are sent on every change. /stations contains the station list (retained, sent again after every change); a call of /list sends it again; an invalid command appears in /status as an error.
t.<code>v</code> ist 0-100 und wird gespei: v is 0-100 and is saved; the volume moves gently to the new value, the time in milliseconds is in the Audio tab and can be overridden per call with ms. Without v, /api/volume only reports: volume (general) and playVolume (currently in effect). /api/status returns state (idle, loading, playing), error, queue (waiting announcements and files), volume (general), playVolume (the volume currently in effect), the free memory and what is playing: source (radio, file, speech), name (station name or file name), title (current title, if the station reports it) and url. For a running file pos and dur (seconds), pm (progress in permille) and rate (permille per second) are added, for a web radio genre, desc, web, logo, host, bitrate, codec, rate (sample rate in Hz), ch and bits, and with the volume matching gainDb.
t.Freie Pins mit Pull-up: bei Kontakt nach: Free pins with pull-up: play an announcement or MP3 file on contact to GND
t.z. B. Die Tür ist offen / gong.mp3: e.g. The door is open / gong.mp3
t.Alle freien Pins liegen mit Pull-up auf: All free pins are held high by a pull-up. If a pin gets contact to GND (for example through a button), the device plays the chosen announcement, MP3 file or web radio station. The pins of the amplifier and the SD card, the strapping pins and the status LED are not shown.
t.Aktion: Ansage = Text, der über VoiceRSS: Action: Announcement = text that is spoken via VoiceRSS. MP3 file = file name from the MP3 (Flash) tab, sd:/Path.mp3 or sd:/Folder/ from the SD card, or a URL (http:// or https://). Web radio = saved station, name or slot number from the Web radio tab. The volume is optional (0-100, empty = general). The pin must stay at GND for about 40 ms; it triggers once per button press.
t.<code>GET /api/pins</code> liefert die f: GET /api/pins returns the free pins: p (number), l (state, 1 = high, 0 = low), t (action), x (text) and v (volume, -1 = general). POST /api/pins with pin, type (say, file, station or empty = no action), text (announcement, file name, sd: path, URL or station) and optionally vol (0-100) saves the action of a pin. It triggers as soon as the pin has contact to GND for about 40 ms.
t.Schaltet das Schreiben des Logs in die D: Switches writing the log to the file off by itself after this many minutes to spare the flash; 0 = never. The time runs from switching on or from the start of the device.
t.Benutzername für den MQTT-Broker (option: User name for the MQTT broker (optional); empty = no login.
t.Passwort für den MQTT-Broker (optional);: Password for the MQTT broker (optional); it is not shown. Leave empty to keep the saved one; without a user it is deleted.
t.Bis zu 5 Server, leere Felder werden übe: Up to 5 servers, empty fields are skipped. The device asks the first three; if no time arrives within 45 s, it tries the others.
t.Sprachdateien (zum Beispiel <code>en.jso: Language files (for example en.json) live in the memory of the device. /upload?target=lang (form, field file) uploads one, GET /api/lang lists the available languages, POST /api/lang with fetch=en loads the file from the project on GitHub, with delete=en deletes it, and /lang.json?l=en returns the file.
t.Lädt die Sprachdatei (zum Beispiel en) a: Loads the language file (for example en) from the lang folder of the project on GitHub (holgiw/netspeaker) into the device; the device needs internet for this. An existing file of the same name is replaced.
t.Zu wenig freier Speicher (Webradio kurz: Not enough free memory (stop the web radio briefly)
t.Leer = <code>netspeaker/&lt;Hostname&gt;: Empty = netspeaker/<hostname>. Already saved topics do not follow a new hostname automatically. Status: off.
Empty = netspeaker/<hostname>. Already saved topics do not follow a new hostname automatically. Status: not connected.

t.Neuer Name nicht erlaubt (Dateien enden: New name not allowed (files end in .mp3)
t.Pins nicht gespeichert: ein Pin ist dopp: Pins not saved: a pin is used twice or not allowed (everything else was saved)
t.Platznummer oder Name angeben: Give a slot number or name

t.SD-Karte ist ausgeschaltet (Tab Audio): SD card is switched off (Audio tab)
t.Name der Stimme (wie bei VoiceRSS):: Name of the voice (as at VoiceRSS):
